headline: Find the right AI expert for your business problem.
lede: Describe what you want to achieve. Greco helps you work out what you need and matches you with vetted AI specialists and agencies. If you already know what you want, search directly.
betaNote: Greco is in private preview. Experts can create their account now; the marketplace opens to clients soon.

terms.title: Clear terms before you pay
terms.body: Price, payment schedule, deadline, revisions and cancellation terms are agreed upfront.

payment.title: Payment through a regulated provider
payment.body: Greco never stores your card. Experts are paid after you accept the work.

disputes.title: Revisions and fair disputes
disputes.body: Request changes, agree partial refunds, or ask Greco to review.
